name: add_internal_note
title: Add internal note
description: Add an internal note to a ticket. Only agents see it; it is never sent to the customer. Name the ticket by its ticket_number, ticket_id or ticket_url, and give the note as plain text or, with content_type text/html, as HTML.

ticket_number.description: The ticket number as shown in Zammad, e.g. "31042" or "Ticket#31042".

ticket_id.description: The internal ID of the ticket, e.g. 8812.

ticket_url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.

text.description: The note, in the format content_type names.

content_type.description: The format of text. text/html for headings, lists, tables or links; Zammad removes unsafe markup.

time_unit.description: The time the user says they spent, where Zammad accounts time; never an estimate.

skip_time_accounting.description: true once the user said they account no time for this message, as Zammad's Skip does. Never on your own.

article_id.description: The internal ID of the note.

ticket_id.description: The internal ID of the ticket.

ticket_number.description: The ticket number as shown in Zammad.

url.description: A link to the ticket in Zammad.
